items.title: Classify the only mechanically safe automatic takeover case
items.context: Add a pure eligibility classifier over a foreign lease: stale heartbeat, canonical cwd equality, local hostname equality, and recorded owner PID proven dead. EPERM, live or reused PID, remote host, malformed identity, and unknown liveness are not eligible.
items.userSees: A stale same-worktree lease with a dead local owner process is recovered automatically; all ambiguous cases remain blocked with a precise reason.
excludes: Automatic takeover of remote or unknown-host leases

items.title: Apply eligible automatic takeover at the unified ownership gate
items.context: In enforceStoryOwnerLeaseGate, after reading and classifying the foreign lease but before the standard rejection, invoke the existing serialized takeover path only for auto-eligible leases. Preserve explicit --takeover and --forceTakeover semantics for every other case.
items.userSees: The originally requested owner-gated command proceeds once after a safe automatic transfer and the new session becomes the sole owner.
excludes: Bypassing ownership for reviewerWrite or readOnly commands

items.title: Record distinct audit evidence and ownership guidance
items.context: Every automatic transfer must append the same structured takeover lineage with an explicit automatic-stale-same-worktree-dead-pid reason and update the takeover counter. session_brief and rejection UX must say whether automatic recovery is eligible, refused, or explicit takeover remains required.
items.userSees: session_brief explains why a lease was auto-recovered or why it remains read-only, and the activity log names the former owner, new owner, and automatic reason.

items.title: Prove no false takeover under real competing processes
items.context: Extend the existing owner-lease smoke with real child processes for stale dead owner success, live long-running owner refusal, PID reuse or start-time mismatch refusal, remote or unknown host refusal, canonical different-worktree refusal, two simultaneous auto-takers yielding one winner, and explicit takeover regression.
items.userSees: The focused smoke prints PASS only when automatic recovery is single-winner and every live or ambiguous owner remains protected.
